editorial_decision_gate.draft_heading: Why AI Citation Tracking Matters Now for Search Strategy
editorial_decision_gate.proposed_text:
AI citation tracking matters now because audience discovery increasingly occurs within generated answers where source links provide direct visibility. Marketers can monitor how frequently generative platforms reference their pages alongside standard search engine results. To begin tracking, assemble a core list of natural language queries, run these across conversational engines, and log which URLs appear as source citations.

Compare your cited pages against competitor links to locate visibility gaps in key topic areas. According to Search Engine Journal (March 2025), 68% of AI Overviews include at least one citation link, making direct verification essential for preserving audience reach. Audit uncited pages against cited competitors to review structural clarity, clear headings, and concise answer formatting.

Track citation status on a regular weekly schedule across multiple generative platforms. Record whether structural content updates lead to changes in citation frequency over time. This systematic audit process helps teams measure and refine their search presence based on observed citation data.
